Updates `GetScopedClientForUser` signature to accept `context.Context` as first parameter and changes OAuth token cleanup to use deferred direct delete instead of resource registration. Updates two existing call sites to pass the test context as the new first argument. | | **Project API test suite: node selector, template propagation, and cascading deletion**
